page.title: Guardrail center
page.desc: Every constraint the pricing engine enforces, with live coverage and breach counts for the current scope.

bounds.name: Price bounds
bounds.desc: Per-SKU minimum and maximum price, intersected with the governing strategy's bounds.

map.name: MAP policy
map.desc: Minimum advertised price. A proposal below MAP is blocked wherever enforcement is on.

max_change.name: Max change per cycle
max_change.desc: Largest single-move price change an active strategy permits, applied around the current price.

auto_approve.name: Auto-approve threshold
auto_approve.desc: Confidence above which a strategy proposal can skip manual review. Observational here — enforced at decision time.

margin_floor.name: Margin floor
margin_floor.desc: Active min-margin rules that hold a SKU's price at or above the margin floor.

staleness.name: Price staleness
staleness.desc: Days since the last price change. Tracked for review queues — not an enforced bound.

breaches.title: Current breaches
breaches.none: No SKU currently breaches a hard constraint.

drill.title: Per-SKU drill-down
drill.noStrategy: No active strategy — product bounds only
drill.noRules: No active rule covers this SKU
